reply_data.body:
Ah, I've found [this](https://gist.github.com/bassamsdata/eec0a3065152226581f8d4244cce9051?permalink_comment_id=5515242#gistcomment-5515242) and [this](https://gist.github.com/bassamsdata/eec0a3065152226581f8d4244cce9051?permalink_comment_id=5515504#gistcomment-5515504) comments.

If the goal of `local cwd = vim.fs.root(buf_id, ".git")` is to find current working directory of the *path that is displayed in the buffer*, then it probably won't work. It will just be the same as `vim.fs.root(vim.uv.cwd(), ".git")` and work only in some cases. And the previous `vim.fn.expand("%:p:h")` would also not take buffer's path into account.

The new buffer names make this (finding cwd of the path that is displayed in the buffer) possible with something like:

```lua
lua path = vim.api.nvim_buf_get_name(buf_id):match('^minifiles://%d+/(.*)$')
lua cwd = vim.fs.root(path, '.git')
```
